messages.subject: For Carol Tome | Global affairs, government relations and international logistics
messages.body:
Dear UPS Media Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Carol Tome, Chief Executive Officer, where appropriate.

UPS operates across global trade, infrastructure, customs, public policy and supply-chain resilience. Those priorities closely match the institutional and regulatory work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior engagement across public institutions and complex operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation regarding roles where this combination of government relations, stakeholder management and cross-functional execution could support UPS across international markets. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to UPS.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
